basis: Phyllodes tumors arise predominantly in breast, with prostate variants; neither has an axis. Lung and skeletal metastases are minority complications.
Chronic immune-mediated inflammation forms subcutaneous masses. Salivary involvement is 5-29%; associated renal disease is separately diagnosed.
Hereditary choroidal dystrophy and atrophy directly affect the eye.
Pontocerebellar maldevelopment causes severe neurologic dysfunction. Bulbar symptoms and central visual impairment do not establish direct gastrointestinal or ocular damage.
Congenital retinal photoreceptor synaptic dysfunction causes stationary visual impairment and abnormal electroretinography.
Invasive carcinoma originates in urinary tract urothelium, including bladder, renal pelvis and ureter.
Benign adipocytic tumor typically arises in subcutaneous tissue, especially the posterior neck, shoulders and back.
Acute myeloid leukemia of megakaryocytic lineage directly involves blood-forming cells and marrow.
Autoinflammatory spectrum; progressive sensorineural hearing loss affects roughly 40-60%. Rash is transient; destructive CNS and joint disease cluster in severe subtypes.
Ovarian germ cell tumor; reproductive location without intrinsic endocrine dysfunction has no axis.
Mature teratoma confined to the ovary; reproductive tissue is outside the axes.
Usually bacterial infection of the endometrium. The uterine location has no anatomical axis, but the infectious mechanism qualifies.
CBS-predominant spectrum: lens disease ~70-90%, skeletal disease ~50-70%, neurologic impairment ~40-60%; vascular injury varies and is omitted at cap.
Neurodevelopmental disorder with universal developmental delay; strabismus affects 7/15 patients (~47%). Hypotonia alone does not establish primary muscle disease.
Defining abnormalities involve the oral palate, midfacial skeleton and sensorineural hearing apparatus.
Nonsyndromic intellectual disability with seizures. Precocious puberty and exodeviation each reported in only one patient do not establish common additional organ involvement.
Defined by abnormal nervous-system reflex responses; no other organ disease is established.
Umbrella for male reproductive organ tumors; endocrine dysfunction and damage to an included organ are not defining across the group.
Malignant B-cell lymphoid neoplasm, primarily nodal; lymphoma qualifies for the immune mechanism axis. No additional organ is commonly directly damaged.
Immune-mediated inflammation of nerve-supplying blood vessels directly causes ischemic peripheral nerve damage.
Cataracts 80-99%; insulin resistance and sensorineural hearing loss 30-79%; gastrointestinal dysmotility omitted at cap. Cardiac disease is generally below 30%.
Syndrome defined by hypogonadotropic hypogonadism and frontoparietal alopecia, affecting endocrine function and hair.
Inherited epidermal disease; ectropion 80-99%, keratitis and corneal erosion 30-79%. Hearing impairment from external canal scaling occurs in 30-79%.
Cavernous vascular lesion arises within retinal blood vessels, defining both ocular and vascular involvement.
Benign adipose neoplasm located in the spermatic cord, a reproductive structure; this location is outside the axes.
